facts.fact: KenTrade says its National Electronic Single Window System, a single entry point for lodging trade documents and paying fees, was upgraded and commissioned on 20 August 2021 with 43 stakeholder institutions onboarded.
facts.system: National Electronic Single Window System (Trade Facilitation Platform)

facts.fact: KenTrade says it achieved full integration with the Kenya Revenue Authority's Integrated Customs Management System (iCMS), giving full automation of the cargo release process.
